interface.signature: check(N: int, M: int, Edges: list) -> bool

preconditions.description: The number of vertices N must be between 1 and 10.
The number of edges M must be between 1 and 15.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edge) == 2 and 1 <= edge[0] <= N and 1 <= edge[1] <= N for edge in Edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge in Edges must be a list of two integers, both within the range of 1 to N.

postconditions.description: The function returns True if a Hamiltonian path exists in the graph.
The function returns False if no Hamiltonian path exists in the graph.
